messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- The Atlas team owns the image resizer as of 2025-11-26, when ownership transferred from the Ember team. [decision; valid 2025-11-26 to now; recorded by handover/2025-11-26-image-resizer]
    earlier: The Ember team owns the image resizer as of 2025-03-20. [decision; valid 2025-03-20 to 2025-11-26; recorded by handover/2025-03-20-image-resizer]
    earlier: The Dune team owns the image resizer. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-03-20; recorded by standup/dune/2025-01-20]
- The product catalog calls the image resizer for thumbnails, so the image resizer is a hard dependency of the product catalog. [valid 2025-04-14 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-04-14]
- As of the 2025-11-26 handover, the image resizer's dashboards and alerts are being repointed. [valid 2025-11-26 to now; recorded by handover/2025-11-26-image-resizer]
- On 2025-10-15, the Atlas team noticed that the image resizer's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send and pinged the owners. [valid 2025-10-15 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-10-15]
- The catalog service still relies on the resizer. [valid 2026-05-27 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-05-27]
- As of 2026-03-17, storage for the image resizer's original uploads has doubled in six months. [valid 2026-03-17 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-03-17]
- On 2026-03-17, the Atlas team decided that the image resizer will keep original uploads for 90 days only, because storage for originals doubled in six months. [decision; valid 2026-03-17 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-03-17]
- Priya Raman is the primary on-call for the Atlas team as of 2025-07-30, when on-call passed from Tomasz. [valid 2025-07-30 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-07-30]
    earlier: Tomasz is the primary on-call for the Atlas team as of 2025-06-19, until the next rotation. [valid 2025-06-19 to 2025-07-30; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-06-19]
    earlier: Priya Raman is the primary on-call for the Atlas team as of 2025-05-13, until the next rotation. [valid 2025-05-13 to 2025-06-19; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-05-13]
    earlier: Tomasz is the primary on-call for the Atlas team as of 2025-04-03, replacing Priya Raman. [valid 2025-04-03 to 2025-05-13; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-04-03]
    earlier: Priya Raman is the primary on-call for the Atlas team starting 2025-02-12. [valid 2025-02-12 to 2025-04-03; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-02-12]
- As of 2026-05-29, Oskar is the primary on-call for the Ember team. [valid 2026-05-29 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-05-29]
    earlier: As of 2026-01-15, Diego is the primary on-call for the Ember team. [valid 2026-01-15 to 2026-05-29; recorded by standup/ember/2026-01-15]
- As of 2026-01-16, Tomasz is off the Dune team on-call rotation. [valid 2026-01-16 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-01-16]
- As of 2026-05-29, Diego is off the Ember team on-call rotation. [valid 2026-05-29 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-05-29]
    earlier: As of 2026-01-15, Oskar is off the Ember team on-call rotation. [valid 2026-01-15 to 2026-05-29; recorded by standup/ember/2026-01-15]
- On 2026-05-22, Tomasz picked up the Dune team on-call shift from Farah. [valid 2026-05-22 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-05-22]
- Oskar takes the first on-call shift of the year for the Ember team. [valid 2025-01-14 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-01-14]
- On 2026-03-20, on-call for the Boreal team passed from Marcus to Lena. [valid 2026-03-20 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-03-20]
- The job scheduler is owned by the Dune team as of 2025-06-25, when ownership moved from the Ember team. [decision; valid 2025-06-25 to now; recorded by handover/2025-06-25-scheduler]
    earlier: The Ember team owns the job scheduler. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-06-25; recorded by standup/ember/2025-01-20]
- The Cinder team owns the job scheduler as of 2025-09-23, when ownership transferred from the Dune team. [decision; valid 2025-09-23 to now; recorded by handover/2025-09-23-scheduler]
    earlier: The Dune team owns the job scheduler as of 2025-09-05. [valid 2025-09-05 to 2025-09-23; recorded by standup/dune/2025-09-05]
- On 2025-07-30, on-call for the Atlas team passed from Tomasz to Priya Raman when Tomasz moved to the Dune team. [valid 2025-07-30 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-07-30]
- As of 2025-09-23, the pager for the job scheduler rings the Cinder team, not the Dune team. [valid 2025-09-23 to now; recorded by handover/2025-09-23-scheduler]
- The Dune team observed on 2025-08-19 that the resizer's cold start time tripled after the runtime upgrade. [valid 2025-08-19 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-08-19-2]

Question: Who is on call for the team that owns image-resizer?

message.reasoning: The image resizer is owned by the Atlas team as of 2025-11-26 (valid to now). The primary on-call for the Atlas team as of 2025-07-30 is Priya Raman, valid to now. So the answer is Priya Raman.
